rules: Exact category/canonical matches outrank exact terms; exact terms outrank prefix; prefix outranks fuzzy.
Apply global term specificity from term-weights.json; common collision terms contribute less than unique terms.
Use query-token coverage as a positive signal.
Use disambiguation-rules.json only as soft context; never hard-filter unless hardExclusions explicitly contains a rule.
Single-token ambiguous queries may legitimately return multiple categories.
Related-category prior is small and may not overpower lexical relevance.
Popularity and personalization are bounded priors and may not overpower relevance.
Protected technical tokens must survive normalization.
Human-style gold benchmark is an independent release gate and must not be generated from the runtime taxonomy at test execution time.
Do not tune ranking to memorize benchmark strings; use benchmark failures to improve general rules/data.
